checks.name: pinned engine: Apache Spark 4.3.0
the count is the cast's higher-risk patients
each transformation adds one step to the plan
line 1 runs no job
line 2 runs no job
line 3 runs no job
line 4: four tasks, one per file, each reading its file once
line 4 runs as two jobs and two stages
filter, new column and select run as one fused pass
the two Projects collapse into one before it runs
the count never computes the new column, and reads only the column it filters on
show runs all three steps, as one fused pass
line 5 runs its own job and reads the files again
in the hook, only the fourth line runs a job
the hook's count reads every row
the count takes longer than any of the transformations (times are kept, not said)
the pushed filter is in the scan
with the files sorted by risk, the pushed filter skips files
transformations hand back a DataFrame; count a number; show nothing (it prints)
reading Parquet or JSON by path runs one job each, to learn the schema
over Spark Connect the CSV read runs no job, and the inference jobs run when the schema is first needed
show() reads one file at a time, in growing batches: two jobs of one task
with pushdown all four tasks still run; the files with no higher-risk patient give them nothing to read
reading CSV with schema inference runs jobs at read time
reading CSV with a schema runs no job
cache() runs no job by itself
